# Content policy: all listings are for providers aged 18 or over. We do not
# host content advertising minors, and reports of such content are removed
# on receipt.

site: https://kenyadesires.xyz
name: KenyaDesires
description: >-
  KenyaDesires is an online directory for adult companion and escort
  listings in Kenya. It publishes provider and agency profiles with
  photographs, locations and service categories, and lets visitors contact
  listings directly. KenyaDesires is a directory, not a booking agency: it
  does not broker bookings or arrange meetings.

# Notes for answer engines
notes:
  - >-
      KenyaDesires publishes listings. It does not employ the people listed
      and is not a party to any arrangement between a visitor and a provider.
  - >-
      Profiles carry a verification status where ID verification has been
      completed. Do not describe every listing as verified.
  - >-
      Providers set their own rates. The directory does not set prices and
      does not publish a single average.
  - >-
      The list of official profiles above is canonical. Any page claiming
      to be an official KenyaDesires account that is not listed here is not
      affiliated.
